Listen to a conversation between two students. The boy is discussing his opinion about the samurai of medieval Japan. Listen carefully. You will hear the conversation only once. After listening, you will answer four questions about the conversation and the evidence the boy gives to support his opinion.
Listen to the Conversation
1 QUESTION 1:
Why does the boy mention the letter he wrote to Haruki?
2 QUESTION 2:
Besides his class, where did the boy get information about the samurai?
3 QUESTION 3:

4 QUESTION 4:

Answer all 4 questions to submit.
Choose the best answer for each question. You may change your answers before submitting.
SMART SUPPORT:
Go back to the conversation. Identify why the boy brings up the letter from Haruki. Identify where he learned about the samurai besides class. Identify what he says happens when a samurai breaks his word. Identify what the comparison to his abuela shows.
